user.description:
CONGRATULATIONS! The iCloud3 v3 Integration has been added to Home Assistant. The next step is to configure the devices you want to track.

Select SUBMIT below, then select CONFIGURE to configure iCloud3.

---

The iCloud3 User Guide will help you get started. Select the question mark (?) in the upper-right corner of this screen to open the “iCloud3 User Guide”. The following chapters will be helpful:
  • ICLOUD COMPONENTS - Provides an overview of the Device Tracker screen,
    the Event Log and the Configure screens that are used to set up iCloud3
  • APPLE ACCOUNT - Covers setting up and logging into your Apple Account.
    It will provide information about your devices including their location.
  • MOBILE APP INTEGRATION - Covers setting up and configuring the Mobile App. 
    It will provide zone enter/exit triggers and location data.
  • EVENT LOG - Provides information on iCloud3 activities to include startup status, 
    errors, alerts, device tracking results, battery information, shortcuts for
    configuring iCloud3 and Actions that can control iCloud3 operations.
  • DASHBOARD BUILDER - Builds an iCloud3 Dashboard showing Device
    Tracking Results and the Event log.

---

🕓 After you click Submit, be patient. HA will scan for your iCloud Devices. It may take up to 30 seconds to discover them all.

reauth_code_from_applecom_login.description:
If you request an Authentication Code but the *Apple Account Sign-In Requested* window or the Text Message never arrives, follow these steps to generate one: 

**① Go to your Apple Account Signin screen** - Click this link to go to your Apple Account Sign-in screen in a web browser  https://appleid.apple.com/ 
* If you are already signed in, sign out 
* If you are on a device with Face ID, cover the camera so you are not automatically signed into your account again.

**② Sign in to your Apple Account** - Enter your _**apple_id**_, tap _**Continue**_, enter your _**password**_, tap _**Sign-in**_. If you are using a device with Face ID (iPhone, iPad), you may have to select _Use a different Apple Account_ to bypass the Face Id process.

* The auth code will be displayed on a Trusted Device as it always is.
* Display the auth code as you normally do.

 _**Do not enter it on apple.com. That will authenticate apple.com, not iCloud3**_

**③ Return to this screen** - If you opened a browser tab (i.e., Windows) to log into your Apple Account, you can close it.

**④ Authenticate iCloud3** - Enter the auth code in the field below and send it to Apple for verification. If it is not accepted, follow these same steps again to get a new code.

reauth_code_from_applecom_login.title: Authenticate › Get a code from apple.com
reauth_code_from_applecom_login.description:
If you request an Authentication Code but the *Apple Account Sign-In Requested* window or the Text Message never arrives, follow these steps to generate one: 

**① Go to your Apple Account Signin screen** - Click this link to go to your Apple Account Sign-in screen in a web browser  https://appleid.apple.com/ 
* If you are already signed in, sign out 
* If you are on a device with Face ID, cover the camera so you are not automatically signed into your account again.

**② Sign in to your Apple Account** - Enter your _**apple_id**_, tap _**Continue**_, enter your _**password**_, tap _**Sign-in**_. If you are using a device with Face ID (iPhone, iPad), you may have to select _Use a different Apple Account_ to bypass the Face Id process.

* The auth code will be displayed on a Trusted Device as it always is.
* Display the auth code as you normally do.

 _**Do not enter it on apple.com. That will authenticate apple.com, not iCloud3**_

**③ Return to this screen** - If you opened a browser tab (i.e., Windows) to log into your Apple Account, you can close it.

**④ Authenticate iCloud3** - Enter the auth code in the field below and send it to Apple for verification. If it is not accepted, follow these same steps again to get a new code.

reauth_code_from_applecom_login.description:
If you request an Authentication Code but the *Apple Account Sign-In Requested* window or the Text Message never arrives, follow these steps to generate one: 

**① Go to your Apple Account Signin screen** - Click this link to go to your Apple Account Sign-in screen in a web browser  https://appleid.apple.com/ 
* If you are already signed in, sign out 
* If you are on a device with Face ID, cover the camera so you are not automatically signed into your account again.

**② Sign in to your Apple Account** - Enter your _**apple_id**_, tap _**Continue**_, enter your _**password**_, tap _**Sign-in**_. If you are using a device with Face ID (iPhone, iPad), you may have to select _Use a different Apple Account_ to bypass the Face Id process.

* The auth code will be displayed on a Trusted Device as it always is.
* Display the auth code as you normally do.

 _**Do not enter it on apple.com. That will authenticate apple.com, not iCloud3**_

**③ Return to this screen** - If you opened a browser tab (i.e., Windows) to log into your Apple Account, you can close it.

**④ Authenticate iCloud3** - Enter the auth code in the field below and send it to Apple for verification. If it is not accepted, follow these same steps again to get a new code.

confirm.description:
## The GitHub iCloud3_Beta Repo (gcobb321/icloud3_v3) is being moved to support {store} installation requirements

iCloud3 was installed from the *iCloud3 Beta* repository (gcobb321/icloud3_v3). That repository is no longer being updated. The iCloud3 Beta versions are now pre-releases in the *iCloud3* repository (gcobb321/icloud3).

### Do this to set up {store} iCloud3 Beta  Installation Settings
Select **Submit** to switch your {store} installation to the iCloud3 repository with its *Pre-release* switch on so you continue to receive the beta versions.

- Nothing is uninstalled or downloaded and Home Assistant does not need to be restarted
- The iCloud3 configuration, devices and entities are not changed
- The *iCloud3 Beta* update entity is replaced by the *iCloud3* update entity
- Turn the iCloud3 *Pre-release* switch off later to only receive the production versions

A newer version of one of your Apple Devices is available. The iCloud3 configuration was updated to use the newer device.

Updated Apple Device for **{device}**:
- {old_device} → {new_device}

If this is wrong, change the name of the device in its *Settings App* to another name. Then select it on the *iCloud3 Configure > Update Device* screen for **{device}**.

confirm.title: iCloud3: {device} (Device Updated)
confirm.description:
### {device} > Newer Apple Device detected

A newer version of one of your Apple Devices is available. The iCloud3 configuration was updated to use the newer device.

Updated Apple Device for **{device}**:
- {old_device} → {new_device}

If this is wrong, change the name of the device in its *Settings App* to another name. Then select it on the *iCloud3 Configure > Update Device* screen for **{device}**.

Select **Submit** to remove this notice.

create_entry.default: The **{device}** notice was removed. **{new_device}** is being tracked.

apple_acct_reassigned.title: iCloud3: {device}, Apple Account updated

confirm.title: iCloud3: {device} (Apple Account Updated)
confirm.description:
### {device} > Apple Account updated

The Apple Account assigned to **{device}** is not in the iCloud3 configuration. Its Apple Device was found in another Apple Account. The iCloud3 configuration was updated to use that Apple Account.

Updated Apple Account for **{device}**:
- {old_apple_acct} → {new_apple_acct}
- Apple Device: {apple_device}

If this is wrong, select the correct Apple Account and Apple Device on the *iCloud3 Configure > Update Device* screen for **{device}**.

Select **Submit** to remove this notice.

create_entry.default: The **{device}** notice was removed. **{apple_device}** is being tracked using the **{new_apple_acct}** Apple Account.
